query: In which city was the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics winner born?

intermediate_answers.answer: The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz, and Anne L'Huillier. Their birth cities are: Pierre Agostini (Tunis, Tunisia), Ferenc Krausz (Mór, Hungary), and Anne L'Huillier (Paris, France).

answer.raw_answer:
## Summary
The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to three scientists: Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz, and Anne L'Huillier. Each laureate was born in a different city: Tunis (Tunisia), Mór (Hungary), and Paris (France), respectively.

## Birthplaces of the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics Laureates

The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz, and Anne L'Huillier for their experimental methods that generate attosecond pulses of light for the study of electron dynamics in matter [Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz, Anne L’Huillier win Nobel Prize for physics | Science and Technology News | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/3/pierre-agostini-ferenc-krausz-anne-lhuillier-win-nobel-prize-for-physics).

The following table summarizes the birth locations for each of the three laureates:

| Laureate | Birth City | Birth Country |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Pierre Agostini | Tunis | Tunisia |
| Ferenc Krausz | Mór | Hungary |
| Anne L'Huillier | Paris | France |

<details>
<summary>Supporting evidence and detailed analysis</summary>

*   **Pierre Agostini:** Official biographical records confirm that Pierre Agostini was born on July 23, 1941, in Tunis, Tunisia [Pierre Agostini | Biography, Nobel Prize, & Facts - Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/biography/Pierre-Agostini). At the time of his birth, Tunisia was a French protectorate [Pierre Agostini | Biography, Nobel Prize, & Facts - Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/biography/Pierre-Agostini).
*   **Ferenc Krausz:** Biographical data from the Academy of Europe and Britannica confirms that Ferenc Krausz was born in 1962 in Mór, Hungary [Ferenc Krausz - Short Biography - Academy of Europe: CV](https://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Krausz_Ferenc/CV) [Ferenc Krausz | Biography, Nobel Prize, & Facts - Britannica](https://www.britannica.com/biography/Ference-Krausz).
*   **Anne L'Huillier:** Biographical records from the Lindau Mediatheque and other sources confirm that Anne L'Huillier was born on August 16, 1958, in Paris, France [CV - Anne L'Huillier - Lindau Mediatheque](https://mediatheque.lindau-nobel.org/laureates/lhuillier/cv) [Anne L'Huillier - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anne_L%27Huillier).

</details>

## Conclusion
The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics laureates—Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz, and Anne L'Huillier—were born in Tunis, Mór, and Paris, respectively. All three individuals were recognized for their pioneering contributions to attosecond physics.
